command: python3 desktop/scripts/test-preset-relocation.py --sdk <locally assembled managed SDK> --out <fresh evidence directory>
summary: The locally assembled managed SDK from this checkout exposes fframes::Styles and was used directly, without the overlay branch. The same src/lib.rs rendered differently under editorial and pulse; a project override changed output; overridden pixels matched after close/reopen and relocation; token, font and resource hashes matched across those stages; inspect without system fonts passed with each preset's bundled font and exited 2 when the font was removed; the checked-in pre-M4 project opened, built and rendered without source/Cargo rewrites.
